about_the_game:
Arsenic & Absinthe is a blend of a chill bartender simulation with a narrative-driven noir but colorful fantasy story set in the 1950s vibe featuring fabled characters with a point-and-click system but also full of dark humor about working life and the suffering of the working class trying to be successful before they age 30 released in the 2025 April Fool's Day.

Story

"Mirror, mirror on the wall, tell me...where is a secret recipe that’ll make me the most successful person of them all?"

Sylene Blackqueen, a broke bartender barely making it from dusk till dawn, suddenly finds herself threatened into handing over her bar’s secret recipe, watching her dreams go poof right before her eyes. Dreams of becoming a success story just like “Snow White.”

But misfortune has a funny way of wearing opportunity’s clothes.

Rumor has it, the Secret Recipe of Success, a recipe said to fix every problem in life, is within her grasp. All she needs to do is hunt it down, crush her business rivals, and maybe ruin a few innocent lives along the way.

Of course, no sane person would actually wreck someone’s life for the sake of wealth.

…Funny. That line sounds familiar.
This isn’t the first time you’ve done this… is it?

----

The player takes on the role of "Sylene", a bartender who recently began a new life, making drinks, serving unusual recipes of art, and listening to the stories of working-class customers. A simple life, however, is merely a dream for her as her haunted past returns. The player has to explore the night city and solve the pre-midlife crisis while getting caught in the notorious "Snow White" murder case once more.

KEY FEATURES

  • ‘Unexpectable’ gameplay of everyday working class life.

  • With more than 10+ customers and your ‘business competitors’, you can talk and listen to the gossip about their story; the mix of a normal employee story, with a fantasy fairytale setting.

  • Various ways how to make a drink to ‘solve customer problems’, or ‘make it worse’.

  • Get ready to point out, clicking around and turning the city upside down to solve a mystery about the murder case.

  • More than colorful 20+ illustrations cutscenes and 20+ drink menus in colorful.

  • The jazzy soundtrack spice up the shift.

  • Translation in Thai (This one is a lie, the game is in Thai but then got translated into English.)


Well, it’s time to stop reading! Clock in, we got revenge to work on today.

content_descriptors.notes:
The developers describe the content like this:

The language used is not suitable for children. Additionally, the game contains references to topics such as the described violence and use of alcohol.

And for adult, the game contain a sensitive topics in workplace such as abusive co-worker, working experience trauma, and toxic workplace situation.

short_description: A Bartender point-and-click simulator game mixed with visual novel-style storytelling set in a noir-fabled world. As you have only 7 days to live, to save yourself from a collapsing life, it’s time to investigate, mix the drink and discover the secret recipe of success you deserve all along.
